The author and related parties are not liable for any direct or indirect losses arising from use of this manager or from obtaining, installing, enabling, or managing any third-party mods / plugins / related files through it. 5. Third-party mods are provided by their authors; the manager and catalog maintainer do not guarantee safety, legality, or quality. Enable at your own risk. Report issues by email. 6. Catalog listing is not an endorsement; the maintainer may refuse, delay, edit metadata, or remove entries. 7. Contact: email llxmod@foxmail.com (mods / reports / feedback); QQ 319323959 (maintainer "院长大人") as secondary. 8. Continued use means you accept this notice. If you do not agree, stop using and uninstall immediately.

data.value: Folder and Steam branch keys are aligned, but the game path is not ready yet (missing binaries or MelonLoader incomplete). Wait for Steam to finish download/verify, then retry.

data.name: HintActiveStoreIncompleteSwitchOther
data.value: If the other branch folder is still complete: fully exit Steam, then switch to that branch — or use Restore Official folder to restore from the complete folder. Steam rewrites the active folder through the Mechabellum junction; do not force operations mid-download.

data.name: FailBranchStoreIncompleteSteamDownload
data.value: The active branch folder is incomplete (often Steam downloading/verifying; GameAssembly.dll missing). Exit Steam, then switch to the complete other folder, or use Restore Official folder to restore from the complete folder; or wait until Steam finishes.

data.name: NotifySettleBlockedDeployFailed

data.name: NotifySettleBlockedAcfNotSettled
data.value: Steam manifest is not stable yet (verify/write). After the download shows complete, wait a moment and confirm again; if it still fails, fully exit Steam and retry.

data.name: LogSettleKeptAwaiting
data.value: Steam settle was not cleared (you can confirm again later).
